##### Project general facts

Equiti Villas introduces comfortable townhouses that combine modern convenience with cozy living, offering the perfect blend of comfort and functionality for discerning residents. Each charming property features an open-concept living area, a well-appointed kitchen with high-end appliances, and a spacious master suite designed for relaxation. With a beautifully landscaped backyard and a two-car garage, these townhouses provide a truly inviting and practical home environment.

The development offers residents a beautifully landscaped backyard that provides an ideal outdoor space for relaxation, entertaining, and family gatherings. The two-car garage ensures ample parking convenience, while the well-appointed kitchens with high-end appliances make culinary experiences a pleasure. Every detail has been thoughtfully designed to create a comfortable and functional living environment.

Each residence features bespoke design and high-quality finishes, creating living spaces that exude sophistication and contemporary elegance. The open-concept living areas maximize space and natural light, while the spacious master suites provide a serene retreat. Furnished and unfurnished units offer flexibility for residents to personalize their homes according to their preferences. 

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in Al Furjan, a residential community in the southern part of Dubai near the Jebel Ali Free Zone and the Dubai Expo site. The community is conveniently located near major highways such as Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro, providing easy access to other parts of the city. The area offers a variety of housing options including apartments, townhouses, and villas, catering to diverse lifestyle needs.

The community is designed to provide a comfortable and luxurious lifestyle with a range of amenities and facilities such as parks, community centers, swimming pools, and sports courts. One of the unique features of the area is its emphasis on green spaces, with parks and landscaped areas spread throughout the community. Residents can enjoy a tranquil environment that promotes well-being and outdoor recreation.

The neighborhood offers convenient access to retail outlets and restaurants located within the community, providing residents with easy access to shopping and dining options. The well-planned infrastructure ensures that everything needed for daily life is close at hand. This distinguished location represents the perfect balance of modern convenience, green living, and community connectivity, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most desirable residential communities.
